messages:
Maria: Quick sync — planning SI onboarding for the Q3 marketplace push. I'm thinking a 6-week onboarding with 2-week mentor rotations + clear certification gates. Need to align on what counts as 'certified for marketplace' and badge rules. Any major objections?
Alex: No objections. Strong +1 for badge requirement. Helps surface partners in the marketplace. Propose 3 gates: knowledge quiz, 20min live demo, and 2 customer shadow sessions. Renewal every 12 months.
Varun: Sounds doable. For rotations, suggest max cohort of 8, mentors rotate every 2 weeks. Also recommend a hardware track for partners doing on-prem/private deployments — need a lab with sample racks + install runbook.
Jessica: Adding that the enablement playbook must include a presales checklist and a joint-announcement runbook (who approves messaging, logos, timelines). Legal usually needs a 3-week lead on external announcements.
Maria: Good call on legal. We should also decide whether the badge is auto-granted after passing or manually reviewed. Ops tradeoff there.
Alex: Manual review adds QA but slows scale. Maybe auto-grant + random manual audits (10% of certs). We can surface fraud flags from usage metrics.
Varun: For the technical cert gate, here's a minimal config we can use as a canonical spec snippet:
```
{
  "gates": ["quiz","demo","shadow"],
  "passing_score": 80,
  "demo_duration_min": 20,
  "required_shadow_sessions": 2,
  "renewal_months": 12
}
```
Use this as a starting point for the automation API.
Jessica: I'll draft the announcement timeline template and the partner-facing checklist. Also want to include a 'customer reference play' in the playbook (who to ask, timing, incentives).
Maria: Next steps: Varun to draft syllabus + hardware lab plan, Alex to own badge integration with marketplace metadata, Jessica to draft announcement/runbook and presales checklist. I'll coordinate mentor recruitment and schedule. I'll set a 30-min alignment sync Thu. @onboard-bot can you set a reminder and open cohort signup on Monday?
onboard-bot: Reminder set: Thursday 10:00 AM PT. Cohort signup scheduled to open Monday 09:00 AM PT. I will post cohort registration link in #partnerships when live.
Alex: I'll also create a mentor-rotation sheet and share it here: https://tiny.redwood/si-mentor-rotations (will add columns for timezone, expertise, max mentees).
Varun: I'll upload the hardware checklist and lab images to the partners repo and link back here once done.
Jessica: Who owns legal stakeholder ping? cc: @Simon
Simon: I'll ping Legal and Security for review and confirm the 3-week SLA. Will report back by EOD Friday. :thumbsup:
Maria: Awesome — thanks all. Invite incoming, agenda will include rollout milestones, cert gating, badge artwork owners, and announcement timeline.
